Please DM for a calendar invite 🙂 Here are the slides 🙂 https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1V3utqODaki03C_UqOEuD9sD_sm_rqSq035nMD_qa7Sg/edit?usp=sharing can't come, will it be recorded? yes👍 My slides from BeamCall #2 My slides: https://hackmd.io/@tcoratger/B16moU0q1x#/ Here are mine: here are mine https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1zjXOUuP_Dyiuxb5w35E4n-EWf8UD4x2oKvKlsIxG_-s/edit?usp=sharing did anyone look at the slashings? we've got 24095 active_slashed validators atm despite good counts of slashings per epoch, i wonder if we're basically only slashing 1 validator or a very small number, per slashing, becuase we're not really getting slashings faster than exits so we're getting a really awful rate of slashing. I think slashers are running, we just dont do well at making good slashings most slashings have a tiny number of validators in them (1-2) and we're only slashing in about 8 blocks per epoch so we're barely exceeding the exit rate wiht the slashing rate. our mass slashing event will take months probably Part of it is probably that most of the slashers aren't on, i do wonder if we get any different slashers running and see if theres better data coming through on that, if we're not going to get to 66% I have a questions: if we were to go with exits/or even slashings, we would only exit validators who are trying to finalize the chain so we would have less chances of finalizing, is that not correct? well, what im trying to do is start a conversation of - do we want to get to 66%, is that likely - if we want 'mass slashing' instead as partially discussed, do we need to change things at this point to get slashers running I think it will be less likely if most of the validators who are active right now leave and the inactive ones are probably not reachable I know this is the fifth time I expressed this but this seems like we are going to shoot ourselves in the foot ok but as a conversation, i understand your opinion and i'd like others I mean, mine is not an opinion really, isn't that what's gonna happen? can we get the 66% is the first obvious question We are 22% away from it last nigth was 55% and today looks like 44-45, so potentially not likely at this point Ok - i know this is going to be annoying but if we cannot finalize, I really do not think holesky makes it at this rate Slashing active participants sounds like taking a gun and just shooting yourself Aka. The participation would tank lower
